recommendation: Keep the audit commit. Do not remove `unknown` from Device.status unless OO makes a new explicit reversal of FHIR-53243.
issue_request: FHIR-32555 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested removal of `unknown` from the Device.status value set because Device.status is record status, not physical device status.
initial_application: Commit c9b35558c450919d6b57bd28e42a836b03056331 (`Preapply FHIR-32555`) removed the `unknown` concept from `source/device/codesystem-device-status.xml`; because `source/device/valueset-device-status.xml` includes the whole Device status CodeSystem, that also removed it from the ValueSet expansion.
additional_context: FHIR-53243 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and explicitly requested adding `unknown` back to `http://hl7.org/fhir/device-status` and therefore the ValueSet, using the R4 definition. PR #3849 / commit b76fa6ef19abe4717b0de45c4cfe1419894424f9 re-added the code and updated the status mapping source; OO 2025-10-27 minutes confirm the later motion.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active Device source correctly retains `unknown` in the CodeSystem, ValueSet include, and status mapping after the later controlling FHIR-53243 decision.
